title: tofieldia glutinosa var. montana
intro: Tofieldia glutinosa var. montana, commonly known as mountain bog asphodel, is a plant species within the family Tofieldiaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, primarily used to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The health benefits of mountain bog asphodel include its potential to reduce inflammation and serve as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
